01

A report before the first cited verse

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid, on His saying:
"About what are they asking one another? About the great news," meaning: "the Qurʾān."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
عَمَّ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ عَنِ النَّبَأِ الْعَظِيمِ ، يَعْنِي: «الْقُرْآنَ»
Edition record 373710 · p. 694Link to report ↗

09
Report from Abū Hurayra 09

Abū Hurayra

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād b. Salama narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim b. Abī l-Najūd, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayra, who said:
"The ḥuqb: eighty years, one day of which is like a sixth of the world."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ أَبِي النَّجُودِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ:
" الْحِقْبُ: ثَمَانُونَ سَنَةً، الْيَوْمُ مِنْهَا كَسُدُسِ الدُّنْيَا "
Edition record 373718 · p. 695Link to report ↗

08

“Indeed, they were not expecting an account”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 78:27).

13
Explanation from Mujāhid 13

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid:

“they will not possess [the power] to address Him”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 78:37).

Explanation from Mujāhid 18

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid:

Edition record 373727 · p. 696Link to report ↗
19
Report from Ibn ʿAbbās 19

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Hushaym narrated to us, from Abū Bishr, from Mujāhid, from Ibn ʿAbbās, who said:
"The Spirit (al-rūḥ) is a matter from the matters of God, a creature from the creatures of God; He fashioned them in the forms of the children of Adam; no angel descends from heaven except that one of the Spirit is with him."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
«الرُّوحُ أَمْرٌ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ، خَلْقٌ مِنْ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ، صَوَّرَهُمْ عَلَى صُوَرِ بَنِي آدَمَ مَا نَزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَلَكٌ إِلَّا مَعَهُ وَاحِدٌ مِنَ الرُّوحِ»
Edition record 373728 · p. 696Link to report ↗
13

“what is right”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 78:38).

20
Explanation from Mujāhid 20

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid, and he said:
what is right [al-Nabaʾ: 38], he said: the truth in the world, and he acted by it. [p. 697] ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, to the same effect.
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، وَقَالَ:
صَوَابًا [النبأ: 38] قَالَ: «حَقًّا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَعَمِلَ بِهِ» . ⦗ص: 697⦘ أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، مِثْلَهُ

14

“the Day when man will observe what his hands have put forth”

An explanation transmitted from al-Ḥasan (Q 78:40).

21
Explanation from al-Ḥasan 21

al-Ḥasan

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: al-Mubārak b. Faḍāla narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, on His saying:
the Day when man will observe what his hands have put forth [al-Nabaʾ: 40], he said: "That is the believer, the shrewd and cautious one; he knew that he has a return, so he sent ahead and sent ahead; and when he was brought to what he had sent ahead, he looked at it and rejoiced"; and the disbeliever will say, ‘Oh, I wish I were dust!’ [al-Nabaʾ: 40] "because he sends no good ahead, so he says: Would that I were dust; but he will not be dust.
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
يَوْمَ يَنْظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ [النبأ: 40] قَالَ: «ذَاكَ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْكَيِّسُ الْحَذِرُ، عَلِمَ أَنَّ لَهُ مَعَادًا فَقَدَّمَ وَقَدَّمَ، فَلَمَّا قُدِمَ عَلَيْهِ نَظَرَ إِلَى مَا قَدَّمَ وَاغْتَبَطَ» ، وَيَقُولُ الْكَافِرُ يَا لَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ تُرَابًا [النبأ: 40] " لِأَنَّهُ لَا يُقَدِّمُ خَيْرًا فَيَقُولُ: يَا لَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ تُرَابًا فَلَا يَكُونُ تُرَابًا
